name: wfc-b-head-rest
caption: The quality-check workflow's reviewer leg, named by its title and its leg ('Visual QA: ai-studio-staging · reviewer leg'). Under today's chips row, one card: what it is meant to deliver on the left; Repository, Feature, Started by, From and When on the right.

name: wfc-b-head-long
caption: A 609-character description of a code lane, held to five lines with a Show all link. The facts column stays beside it; From reads Claude Code.

name: wfc-b-head-long-open
caption: The same description after Show all: the whole text, and Show less. The card grows down and pushes the grid down.

name: wfc-b-head-generated
caption: A description nobody submitted: a 'generated' chip beside the label, the text in the dim ink, and a visible line under it saying a model wrote it. From says Schedule and names the schedule.

name: wfc-b-head-nofeature
caption: No feature: the Feature row keeps its slot with a 'none' mark (asked, and there is none), never an empty gap.

name: wfc-b-list
caption: The Workflows list with a narrow Repository column on every row: the repository's name, with its owner in faint ink under it. Titles wrap and read whole. Spent's coverage note sits under its figure. The two quality-check legs read '· reviewer leg' and '· moderator leg', here and in Recent.

name: wfc-b-head-rest-1280
caption: The quality-check page at 1280. The inspector folds to its rail, so the card has the width and the description runs to three lines.

name: wfc-b-head-rest-390
caption: On a phone the facts stack under the description, with a rule between them. The labels and values keep their two columns.

name: wfc-b-list-390
caption: On a phone the Repository column gives way: the whole owner/repo goes under each title. Titles wrap and read whole, and Steps is a count rather than a bar, so the title has the width.

name: wfc-b-head-leg
caption: The moderator leg of the same quality check. It has the same title as the reviewer leg and is told apart by '· moderator leg' on the heading, the breadcrumb and Recent, and by its own description. From reads Quality check.

name: wfc-b-head-lane
caption: The code lane: its feature links to the issue, From reads 'Issue run · issue #3201', and the pull request stays in the chips row.
